english.title: Water undertaker fail to assist / give information to assessor appointed to enforce water quality
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a

(A)_[water undertaker,]_
(B)_[water supplier licensee,]_
(C)_[relevant person as defined in section 70(1A) of the Water Industry Act 1991,]_

failed

(D)_[to give to **(..SPECIFY INSPECTOR..), an inspector appointed under section 86 of the Water Industry Act 1991 all such assistance]_
(E)_[to provide **(..SPECIFY INSPECTOR..), an inspector appointed under section 86 of the Water Industry Act 1991 with all such information]_

as that person may reasonably have required for the purpose of carrying out any such investigation as is mentioned in section 86(2) of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 86(3) and (6) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a water undertaker / licensed water supplier / relevant person
as defined in section 70(1A) of the Water Industry Act 1991
without reasonable excuse
failed to give an inspector all such assistance / provide him/her with all such information as that person may reasonably have required for the purpose of carrying out any such investigation as is mentioned in section 86(2) of that Act

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The Water (Special Measures) Act 2025 increased the penalty for this offence from the 24th April 2025. See H18260 for the offence applying before this date.

other.penalty:
Either waySummary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 110(3E)(a) of this Act and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
